newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers soft in year-end rush by sellers.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers soft in year-end rush by sellers.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotations were weaker on Friday, amid selling by some majors to reach 1996 sales targets, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $130 by most sellers, down from $132/$135 on Thursday. Bunker 380-cst were quoted at $123.25, down from $126-$127.
"The sellers want to get rid of their 1996 quota supplies," said a trader. However demand was not healthy, said the trader. "It may pick up later today," he said.
MDO and gas oil were steady at $231-$245, $255-$262 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
